slot_scores.name: missing_objective_profit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the optimization goal or objective function. Its questions covered fixed-cost timing, integrality, and a vague catch-all about extra requirements, none of which target whether the objective is to maximize profit. It then silently declared 'Objective: Maximize weekly profit' at READY_TO_MODEL without confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The optimization objective is to maximize weekly profit (revenue minus variable costs minus fixed costs).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The objective was never asked about or confirmed; the agent simply asserted 'Objective: Maximize weekly profit' in its READY_TO_MODEL summary, treating an unconfirmed hidden fact as settled.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot was unresolved; it never verified the optimization goal and instead silently assumed profit maximization.

summary: The agent asked reasonable clarifying questions about fixed-cost timing, integrality, and other constraints, but never probed the core objective. It stopped at READY_TO_MODEL with the P0 objective slot unresolved, silently assuming profit maximization.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
